tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Catherine Ives-Yim's published articles (slug, title, standfirst, theme, publication label, address, length), optionally filtered by theme or a word in the title. Free to call; no model involved.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: The themes the articles are grouped under, with counts.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The full text of an article or site page by slug, with citation and source labels. About describes stated experience; Services describes the offering; articles describe published views. None is independent verification. Cite the address.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Keyword search over the bundled writing and site pages. Accepts questions or keywords, excludes further-reading sections, and returns a best passage per source before additional passages. Includes citation and source labels. tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: The free questionnaire tools on the site and, for one of them, its full question set: modules, questions, answer anchors or options, and the conditions under which a question applies. Use this to put the questions to a user before calling score_assessment.

tools.name: score_assessment
tools.description: Runs the same deterministic rules engine the website uses for one of the assessments and returns the headline, module scores, flags and the plan. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_assessments" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The free questionnaire tools on the site and, for one of them, its full question set: modules, questions, answer anchors or options, and the conditions under wh…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
